newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold closes up, silver ends down.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold closes up, silver ends down.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closed 10 rupees higher at 4,845 rupees per 10 gramme against the previous close of 4,835 rupees but down five rupees against the opening level of 4,850 rupees as light profit-taking trimmed early gains towards the close.

** Prices of gold biscuits (116.50 gramme) closed steady at 56,600 rupees per piece against the previous close but down 100 rupees against the opening level of 56,700 rupees as improved arrivals at the higher level dragged prices lower towards the close.

** Silver (.999) closed steady at 7,080 rupees per kg against the previous close but down 20 rupees against the opening level of 7,100 rupees as fresh arrivals of the imported silver weakened market sentiment towards the close.
